title: Thread Battery Endpoint Silent for Twelve Hours
app: Home Assistant, Matter and Thread border routers, Alexa routine logs, Google Home automations, Zigbee2MQTT bridges, SmartThings, Node-RED, and webhooks streamed to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=thread:router
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by endpoint
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>12
| sort - hours_since
description: Uses Thread endpoint telemetry telemetry to monitor how long battery-powered endpoints have been silent in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for devices that may have died or fallen off the mesh, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Thread endpoint telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Endpoint table of hours since last update.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates how long battery-powered endpoints have been silent so you can spot devices that may have died or fallen off the mesh before it becomes annoying.
